sql: select COALESCE(SUM(total_price), 0) as total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) as order_count, COALESCE(SUM(gross_profit), 0) as gross_profit from "fact_order_items" where "workspace_id" = ? limit 1

select order_date as date, COALESCE(SUM(total_price), 0) as revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) as order_count from "fact_order_items" where "workspace_id" = ? group by "order_date" order by "order_date" asc

select c.id as category_id, c.name as category_name, COALESCE(SUM(i.total_price), 0) as revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT i.order_id) as order_count from "fact_order_items" as "i" inner join "dim_categories" as "c" on "c"."id" = "i"."category_id" and "c"."workspace_id" = "i"."workspace_id" where "i"."workspace_id" = ? group by "c"."id", "c"."name" order by "revenue" desc

select r.id as region_id, r.name as region_name, r.code as region_code, COALESCE(SUM(i.total_price), 0) as revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT i.order_id) as order_count from "fact_order_items" as "i" inner join "dim_regions" as "r" on "r"."id" = "i"."region_id" and "r"."workspace_id" = "i"."workspace_id" where "i"."workspace_id" = ? group by "r"."id", "r"."name", "r"."code" order by "revenue" desc
